title: Information asymmetry and cross-class coalitions in economic liberalization: Theory and evidence from post-communist transition
title_zh: 经济自由化中的信息不对称与跨阶级联盟：来自后共产主义转型的理论与证据
title_primary: 经济自由化中的信息不对称与跨阶级联盟：来自后共产主义转型的理论与证据
title_secondary: Information asymmetry and cross-class coalitions in economic liberalization: Theory and evidence from post-communist transition
authors: Shiyan Cao
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: After the collapse of Soviet-style planned economies, the liberalization of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was considered critical for fostering technology adoption and achieving economic development. On the political side, the naïve expectation was that workers would welcome FDI, whereas the current industrial elite would oppose it. In reality, however, workers and managers often formed a powerful bloc against liberalization. This paper develops a formal model to explain why managers and labor unions may form political coalitions during periods of reform and how information asymmetry between managers and workers influences their policy choices. Since managers possess more information about economic conditions, they can sometimes persuade workers to perceive the managers’ preferred policy as the best option for workers’ welfare. If workers believe that managers’ interests are somewhat aligned with theirs and that managers possess a moderate informational advantage, managers can persuade workers that protectionist policies are in their best interest. In contrast, a misalignment of interests or an excessively large informational disparity might lead to excessive liberalization. The logic of this model can help inform policy debates on how domestic politics affect FDI policies.
abstract_zh: 在苏联式计划经济体制崩溃之后，外国直接投资（FDI）的自由化被视为促进技术采纳和实现经济发展的关键。在政治层面，人们曾天真地预期工人会欢迎FDI，而现有的工业精英则会反对。然而，现实中，工人与管理者往往结成强大的联盟反对自由化。本文构建了一个正式模型，用以解释为何在改革时期管理者和工会可能形成政治联盟，以及管理者与工人之间的信息不对称如何影响他们的政策选择。由于管理者掌握更多关于经济状况的信息，他们有时能说服工人相信管理者偏好的政策是对工人福利最有利的选择。如果工人认为管理者的利益与自身利益存在一定的一致性，且管理者拥有适度的信息优势，那么管理者便能说服工人相信保护主义政策符合他们的最佳利益。相反，利益不一致或信息差距过大则可能导致过度自由化。该模型的逻辑有助于为国内政治如何影响FDI政策的政策辩论提供参考。

title: Inferring Structural Beliefs from Macroeconomic Expectations: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 从宏观经济预期推断结构性信念：来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 从宏观经济预期推断结构性信念：来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Inferring Structural Beliefs from Macroeconomic Expectations: Evidence from Brazil
authors: Mr. Philip Barrett
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I analyze multi-horizon market forecasts for macroeconomic variables in Brazil from 2010 to 2026, using a structural macroeconomic model to interpret stated beliefs as the outcomes of a coherent belief system. This produces time-varying beliefs about policy rules, transmission mechanisms, and structural shocks. Beliefs about the monetary policy rule vary in two distinct dimensions, with the perceived target and Taylor response coefficients showing independent variation. Monetary transmission is seen as weak; the perceived Philips and IS curves are very flat. Markets see fiscal policy as increasingly unresponsive to higher debt. The perceived inflation target is unchanged after an unexpected monetary tightening, but the perceived response to inflation increases, with larger effects for monetary surprises and smaller for news shocks.
abstract_zh: 我分析了2010年至2026年间巴西宏观经济变量的多期限市场预测，利用结构宏观经济模型将所述信念解释为连贯信念体系的产物。这产生了关于政策规则、传导机制和结构性冲击的时变信念。对货币政策规则的信念在两个不同维度上变化，感知目标与泰勒反应系数呈现独立变动。货币传导被视为疲弱；感知的菲利普斯曲线和IS曲线非常平坦。市场认为财政政策对债务上升的响应日益减弱。在意外货币紧缩后，感知的通胀目标未变，但对通胀的感知响应增强，其中货币冲击的影响更大，而新闻冲击的影响较小。

title: Can machine learning improve CEO selection?
title_zh: 机器学习能否改善CEO选拔？
title_primary: 机器学习能否改善CEO选拔？
title_secondary: Can machine learning improve CEO selection?
authors: Hongyan Fang, Xinyu Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Selecting the right CEO is critical to firm success, yet boards must evaluate candidates before observing future performance. This paper examines whether machine learning can improve the hard‑information component of CEO selection by using appointment‑time public information to predict early CEO turnover. Using CEO appointments in Chinese listed firms from 2004 to 2022, we apply XGBoost to predict performance-induced turnover and forced turnover within 2 years of appointment. XGBoost yields stronger out-of-sample predictions than AIC-selected OLS and logit models, and its prediction gains map into decision-relevant screening outcomes. Candidate-pool analyses show that XGBoost rankings remain informative against internal and external benchmarks. SHAP-based interpretation reveals that the model identifies both conventional and unconventional predictors, along with important interactions. Further, the model performs better in non-state-owned firms, suggesting algorithmic screening is most useful where CEO evaluation is market-driven. Overall, our findings suggest machine learning can provide a complementary, auditable screening benchmark for CEO selection. KEYWORDS: CEO selection machine learning XGBoost CEO turnover model interpretation JEL CLASSIFICATION: C10 G30 M12 M51 Acknowledgements The authors thank Jianjun Jia, Guangwei Li, Lei Wang and Su Wang for their helpful comments and suggestions, as well as seminar participants at ShanghaiTech University, the 2023 Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Special Issue Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Corporate Finance, and the internal conference at Shanghai University of International Business and Economics for helpful discussions.
abstract_zh: 选择合适的CEO对企业成功至关重要，然而董事会必须在观察未来业绩之前评估候选人。本文探讨了机器学习能否通过利用任命时的公开信息预测CEO早期更替，从而改善CEO选拔中的硬信息组成部分。利用2004年至2022年中国上市公司的CEO任命数据，我们应用XGBoost预测任命后两年内因业绩导致的更替和强制更替。XGBoost在样本外预测方面优于基于AIC选择的OLS和Logit模型，其预测增益转化为决策相关的筛选结果。候选人池分析显示，XGBoost排名在内部和外部基准下仍具有信息量。基于SHAP的解释揭示，该模型识别了传统和非传统的预测因子，以及重要的交互作用。此外，该模型在非国有企业中表现更佳，表明算法筛选在CEO评估以市场为导向时最为有用。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，机器学习可以为CEO选拔提供一种互补且可审计的筛选基准。关键词：CEO选拔；机器学习；XGBoost；CEO更替；模型解释 JEL分类：C10 G30 M12 M51 致谢：作者感谢Jianjun Jia、Guangwei Li、Lei Wang和Su Wang的有益评论与建议，以及上海科技大学、2023年《太平洋盆地金融杂志》关于公司金融中人工智能与机器学习的特刊会议和上海对外经贸大学内部会议的与会者们的有益讨论。

title: Limited awareness and message feasibility in cheap talk
title_zh: 廉价谈话中的有限认知与信息可行性
title_primary: 廉价谈话中的有限认知与信息可行性
title_secondary: Limited awareness and message feasibility in cheap talk
authors: Z. Shui, B. Cui, Jian Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This note studies how limited awareness affects cheap talk through message feasibility. A receiver is already aware of a new state, while the sender may be unable to formulate the associated message. We characterize monotone informative equilibria in a three-state game where the sender becomes aware of the new state with an exogenous probability before observing the payoff-relevant state. Prior awareness partially restores the common-awareness mimicking constraint. The new-state message may identify the payoff-relevant state, combine state and awareness information, or remain informative by revealing the sender's awareness even when it no longer identifies the state.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了有限意识如何通过信息传递的可行性影响廉价交谈。接收者已意识到新状态的存在，而发送者可能无法构建相应的信息。我们在一个三状态博弈中刻画了单调信息均衡，其中发送者在观察到与收益相关的状态之前，以外部给定的概率意识到新状态。先验意识部分恢复了共同意识下的模仿约束。新状态信息可能识别收益相关状态，结合状态与意识信息，或即便不再识别状态，也能通过揭示发送者的意识而保持信息性。

title: The Autoregressive Inverse‐Wishart Multivariate Stochastic Volatility Model and Its Factor Extension
title_zh: 自回归逆威沙特多元随机波动模型及其因子扩展
title_primary: 自回归逆威沙特多元随机波动模型及其因子扩展
title_secondary: The Autoregressive Inverse‐Wishart Multivariate Stochastic Volatility Model and Its Factor Extension
authors: Xin Jin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Despite its conceptual appeal, the autoregressive inverse‐Wishart (AIW) multivariate stochastic volatility model has been hindered by inefficient sampling methods. The existing samplers for the latent covariance matrix severely suffer from the curse of dimensionality and only work when the dimension is very low. In this paper, we introduce a new proposal for the latent covariance matrix in the AIW model, which demonstrates far better scalability. We introduce different extensions to the basic AIW model that capture various stylized volatility features. We further fit the AIW model into a factor structure and provide an a posteriori identification procedure without introducing order dependence. When evaluated using real datasets ranging from 10 assets to 1000 assets, the new AIW‐based models, whether the standalone versions or the factor versions, are especially suited for multivariate volatility modeling in a wide range of dimensions.
abstract_zh: 尽管自回归逆威沙特（AIW）多元随机波动模型在概念上具有吸引力，但其低效的采样方法一直制约其应用。现有针对潜在协方差矩阵的采样器严重受困于维度灾难，仅能在极低维度下运行。本文为AIW模型中的潜在协方差矩阵提出了一种新方案，该方案展现出显著更优的可扩展性。我们引入基础AIW模型的不同扩展形式，以捕捉各类典型波动特征。进一步将AIW模型嵌入因子结构，并设计了一种无需引入顺序依赖的后验识别程序。基于10至1000个资产规模的真实数据集评估表明，无论是独立版本还是因子版本的新型AIW模型，均特别适用于广泛维度下的多元波动率建模。

title: Large Datasets for the Euro Area and Its Member Countries and the Dynamic Effects of the Common Monetary Policy
title_zh: 欧元区及其成员国的大数据集与共同货币政策的动态效应
title_primary: 欧元区及其成员国的大数据集与共同货币政策的动态效应
title_secondary: Large Datasets for the Euro Area and Its Member Countries and the Dynamic Effects of the Common Monetary Policy
authors: Matteo Barigozzi, Claudio Lissona, Lorenzo Tonni
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce EA‐MD‐QD, a new publicly available dataset comprising 1136 macroeconomic time series for the euro area (EA) and its ten largest member countries observed at monthly or quarterly frequency. Since January 2024, EA‐MD‐QD has been updated monthly and continuously revised, providing a valuable resource for policy analysis in the EA. Using EA‐MD‐QD, we study country‐specific impulse responses to an EA‐wide monetary policy shock. Results reveal moderate yet significant cross‐country heterogeneity, with differences between so‐called core countries, such as France and Germany, and peripheral countries, such as Italy and Spain, in their price and interest rate responses, together with meaningful differences in real activity, while stock price responses are relatively homogeneous. Evidence points to homeownership and saving behavior as potential drivers of the observed cross‐country differences.
abstract_zh: 我们推出EA-MD-QD，这是一个新的公开数据集，包含欧元区及其十个最大成员国的1136个月度或季度宏观经济时间序列。自2024年1月起，EA-MD-QD每月更新并持续修订，为欧元区政策分析提供了宝贵资源。利用EA-MD-QD，我们研究了各国对欧元区整体货币政策冲击的特定脉冲响应。结果显示，各国之间存在适度但显著的异质性：法国和德国等所谓核心国家与意大利和西班牙等外围国家在价格和利率响应上存在差异，实际经济活动方面也有显著不同，而股票价格响应则相对同质。证据表明，住房拥有率和储蓄行为是观察到的跨国差异的潜在驱动因素。

title: Bayesian Fairness: Reward Rule and Disappointment under Information Asymmetry
title_zh: 贝叶斯公平：信息不对称下的奖励规则与失望
title_primary: 贝叶斯公平：信息不对称下的奖励规则与失望
title_secondary: Bayesian Fairness: Reward Rule and Disappointment under Information Asymmetry
authors: Pongou, Roland, Sidie, Ghislain Junior
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We provide an axiomatic foundation for the classical problem of compensating workers when effort is unobserved. The employer holds Bayesian beliefs about workers’ effort, observes output precisely or imprecisely, and seeks fairness. We introduce axioms tailored to this asymmetric-information environment and show that they determine a unique closed-form reward rule, the informational Bayesian value (IBV). The IBV can be interpreted as a contract between an uninformed employer and workers. We then analyze worker disappointment under this rule and show that average disappointment is zero, whether evaluated ex-post, interim, or ex-ante. Consequently, fair compensation prevents worker disappointment in the long run.
abstract_zh: 我们为努力不可观测时工人补偿的经典问题提供了公理化基础。雇主对工人的努力持有贝叶斯信念，能够精确或非精确地观测产出，并追求公平性。我们针对这一信息不对称环境引入了特定公理，并证明这些公理唯一确定了一个闭式奖励规则——信息贝叶斯价值（IBV）。IBV可被解释为不知情雇主与工人之间的契约。随后我们分析了该规则下的工人失望程度，结果表明无论是事后、中期还是事前评估，平均失望度均为零。因此，公平补偿能够在长期中防止工人产生失望情绪。

title: Sovereign Debt Restructuring and Reduction in Debt-to-GDP Ratio
title_zh: 主权债务重组与债务-GDP比率降低
title_primary: 主权债务重组与债务-GDP比率降低
title_secondary: Sovereign Debt Restructuring and Reduction in Debt-to-GDP Ratio
authors: Ando, Sakai, Asonuma, Tamon, Mishra, Prachi, Sollaci, Alexandre
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How do sovereign debt restructurings affect debt-to-GDP ratios? We explore this empirically using a comprehensive dataset covering 115 countries over 1950–2021. After addressing selection bias through an Augmented Inverse Probability Weighted estimator, we show that restructurings significantly reduce debt-to-GDP ratios over 1-5 years, with the effects working primarily through debt levels. The effect is larger when restructurings are combined with fiscal consolidation. We find heterogeneity depending on the creditor type, and the type and size of debt relief. In the short run, restructurings with higher creditor coordination, face value reductions, and larger debt reliefs, reduce debt-to-GDP ratios more effectively.
abstract_zh: 主权债务重组如何影响债务与GDP的比率？我们利用涵盖1950-2021年115个国家的综合数据集对此进行了实证研究。通过采用增强逆概率加权估计量解决选择偏差后，我们发现重组在1-5年内显著降低了债务与GDP的比率，其效果主要通过债务水平发挥作用。当重组与财政整顿相结合时，这一效应更为显著。我们还发现，效果因债权人类型、债务减免的类型和规模而异。在短期内，债权人协调程度更高、面值削减幅度更大以及债务减免规模更大的重组，能更有效地降低债务与GDP的比率。

title: Greasing the wheels of collaboration: Evidence from transfers of university presidents in China
title_zh: 润滑协作之轮：来自中国大学校长调任的证据
title_primary: 润滑协作之轮：来自中国大学校长调任的证据
title_secondary: Greasing the wheels of collaboration: Evidence from transfers of university presidents in China
authors: Chang Xue, Lijuan Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Academic collaboration is a key driver of innovation. Using international journal publication data, this study examines how transfers of university presidents among 111 prestigious public universities in China affect inter-university academic collaboration. Based on PPML estimates, we find that appointing a president to a university who has previously studied or worked at another university leads to an approximately 10% increase in the quantity of collaboration between the two institutions during the president’s period in office at the receiving university. In contrast, comparable transfers of university party secretaries do not generate such effects. The impact of presidential transfers is stronger for collaboration within the president’s own field of study, for university pairs that are geographically more distant, and for presidents who face stronger promotion incentives. In addition, presidential transfers stimulate collaboration regardless of whether the president’s current university or the connected university is listed as the first affiliation on a publication.
abstract_zh: 学术合作是创新的关键驱动力。本研究利用国际期刊发表数据，考察了中国111所重点公立大学校长流动对校际学术合作的影响。基于PPML估计，我们发现，任命一位曾在其他大学学习或工作的校长，在其任职期间，两校间的合作数量大约增加10%。相比之下，类似的大学党委书记调动并未产生此类效应。校长流动的影响在校长自身研究领域内的合作中更为显著，对于地理距离更远的大学配对以及面临更强晋升激励的校长而言，效果更为突出。此外，无论校长当前所在大学还是关联大学是否被列为论文的第一署名单位，校长流动均能促进合作。

title: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
title_zh: 质量、选择与拥堵：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果
title_primary: 质量、选择与拥堵：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果
title_secondary: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
authors: Gautam Gowrisankaran, Kelli R. Marquardt, Robert Town
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察医院质量、患者选择及拥堵状况对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制不可观测的选择效应。重症监护病房负荷加剧了医院死亡率：若无拥堵，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析表明：若患者获知容量压力信息且认为质量信号更精确，死亡率将下降3.8%。然而，若使用更精确的信息却未考虑拥堵因素，新冠死亡人数反而会上升3.8%。

title: How default risk shapes social choice
title_zh: 违约风险如何塑造社会选择
title_primary: 违约风险如何塑造社会选择
title_secondary: How default risk shapes social choice
authors: W. Höchtl, Rudolf Kerschbamer, Philipp Kircher, Sandra Ludwig, Alvaro Sandroni
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper reports the results of an experimental study investigating the role of uncertainty for pro-social behavior. We compare settings in which the decision-maker is solely responsible for the outcome to settings in which his choice is only implemented with some probability while with the complementary probability a “default” is implemented. We find that a sufficiently high probability of the default is necessary to alter decisions. Sufficiently-high-probability defaults lead to less giving by pro-social decision-makers, not only when the default is generous to the receiver but also when it is selfish. This violates monotonicity and is thus not consistent with expected utility theory nor with notions of ex ante fairness.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了一项实验研究的结果，旨在探讨不确定性对亲社会行为的作用。我们比较了决策者独自对结果负责的情境，与决策者的选择仅以一定概率被实施，而互补概率下则执行“默认”选项的情境。研究发现，只有当默认选项的概率足够高时，才能改变决策行为。高概率的默认选项会导致亲社会决策者的给予减少，不仅当默认选项对接收者慷慨时如此，当默认选项为自私时也同样如此。这一现象违反了单调性，因此既不符合预期效用理论，也不符合事前公平的概念。

title: DP21634 Trapped at Home: Weather Shocks, Income, and International Migration
title_zh: 困于家中：天气冲击、收入与国际移民
title_primary: 困于家中：天气冲击、收入与国际移民
title_secondary: DP21634 Trapped at Home: Weather Shocks, Income, and International Migration
authors: Céline Azémar, Rodolphe Desbordes, Markus Eberhardt, Eric Neumayer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: By mid-century, climate change is expected to push millions of migrants across borders, yet direct empirical evidence is limited. Using recent monthly bilateral flow data for 127 developing-country origins and 180 destinations, we estimate migration responses to weather shocks. High-dimensional fixed-effects absorb all origin-, destination-, and migration corridor-by-year confounders, seasonality, and global shocks; identification exploits residual within-corridor weather anomalies. We find no evidence that climate stress raises emigration: higher origin temperatures reduce outflows, while precipitation has no effect. Complementary analysis pinpoints depressed origin income as an underlying mechanism: climate stress tightens household budgets, decreasing the financial viability of international movement.
abstract_zh: 到本世纪中叶，气候变化预计将推动数百万移民跨越国界，然而直接的实证证据仍然有限。利用近期127个发展中国家来源地和180个目的地的月度双边流动数据，我们估算了移民对天气冲击的反应。高维固定效应吸收了所有来源地、目的地及迁移走廊-年份的混杂因素、季节性和全球冲击；识别依赖于残差走廊内的天气异常。我们没有发现气候压力增加移民外流的证据：来源地温度升高反而减少了流出量，而降水则无影响。补充分析指出，来源地收入下降是潜在机制：气候压力收紧家庭预算，降低了国际迁移的经济可行性。

title: Demand Iteration Speed as a Driver of Economic Growth in Saturated Economies
title_zh: 饱和经济中需求迭代速度作为经济增长的驱动力
title_primary: 饱和经济中需求迭代速度作为经济增长的驱动力
title_secondary: Demand Iteration Speed as a Driver of Economic Growth in Saturated Economies
authors: HE, XIULEI
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62,000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
abstract_zh: 当人口增长停滞且人均实物消费趋于饱和时，传统供给侧增长模型已无法解释发达经济体的持续放缓。本文提出"需求迭代速度"概念——即单位时间内特定产品或服务的重复购买频率，并将其嵌入消费支出的国民核算分解框架。研究表明，消费增长率等于人口增长率、单次交易消费量增长率与平均迭代速度增长率之和。这一分解揭示出，在后增长时代，迭代速度成为经济增长的决定性结构变量，为解释从耐用品基础设施到高频数字服务的历史增长引擎更替提供了统一视角。我们将该框架应用于香港这一成熟小型开放经济体，识别出四个可支撑其长期增长的高迭代部门。

title: Economic integration and diffusion of regulatory standards: Evidence from trade networks
title_zh: 经济一体化与监管标准的扩散：来自贸易网络的证据
title_primary: 经济一体化与监管标准的扩散：来自贸易网络的证据
title_secondary: Economic integration and diffusion of regulatory standards: Evidence from trade networks
authors: Sergio H. Rocha, Prakrati Thakur
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We document network effects in the diffusion of regulatory standards through international trade. Using both an instrumental variables approach, based on the time‐varying geographic component of trade, and a recentering approach, exploiting the timing of regulation adoption, we provide robust evidence that countries tend to domestically adopt the regulations of their key trade partners, especially when imposed by their export destinations. Leveraging the high dimensionality of our data, we show that the diffusion process is stronger for regulations and products with observable compliance. Our findings imply that economic integration can strengthen regulatory standards, aiding international policy coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了监管标准通过国际贸易扩散的网络效应。利用基于贸易时间变化地理成分的工具变量方法，以及利用监管采纳时机的重新中心化方法，我们提供了有力证据表明，各国倾向于在国内采纳其主要贸易伙伴的监管规定，尤其是当其出口目的地实施这些规定时。借助我们数据的高维特性，我们展示了对于具有可观察合规性的法规和产品，扩散过程更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，经济一体化能够加强监管标准，有助于国际政策协调。

title: Antimicrobial Use in Livestock: The Economic Cost of Action or Inaction
title_zh: 畜牧业中抗生素的使用：行动或不行动的经济成本
title_primary: 畜牧业中抗生素的使用：行动或不行动的经济成本
title_secondary: Antimicrobial Use in Livestock: The Economic Cost of Action or Inaction
authors: Alejandro Acosta, Wondmagegn Tirkaso, Marco Artavia, Francesco Nicolli, Thomas Chatzopoulos 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper quantifies the economy‐wide consequences of two independent global stress‐tests in livestock production. The first assesses the effects of phasing out antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs), and the second evaluates the long‐term impacts of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) progression. We use a sequential, one‐way modelling framework combining a global partial equilibrium (PE) model and a global computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to trace how scenario‐defined shocks in livestock production propagate through world agricultural markets and the wider economy. The highest‐impact AGPs phase‐out scenario results in cumulative global livestock production losses, valued at constant 2021–2023 prices, of roughly USD 53 billion over 2025–2040, with annual deviations that peak in the mid‐2020s and then decline as output converges along scenario‐defined recovery paths. In contrast, the highest‐impact AMR scenario produces persistent and compounding reductions by construction, with cumulative production losses of about USD 318 billion by 2040, while cumulative economy‐wide welfare losses in this high‐impact case reach approximately USD 1.25 trillion, concentrated mainly in upper–middle‐income countries. Results are scenario dependent by construction and represent indicative orders of magnitude rather than forecasts. The baseline implicitly reflects prevailing levels of AGPs and AMR embedded in historical production trends. The study provides a framework for quantifying the production effects of antimicrobial use (AMU) and their economy‐wide spillovers, highlighting the asymmetric timing of the economic costs of action and inaction under the imposed scenario structure.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了畜牧业生产中两项独立全球压力测试对整体经济的影响。第一项评估了逐步淘汰抗生素生长促进剂（AGPs）的效应，第二项评估了抗生素耐药性（AMR）持续发展的长期影响。我们采用序贯单向建模框架，结合全球局部均衡（PE）模型与全球可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，追踪情景设定的畜牧业生产冲击如何通过世界农产品市场及更广泛的经济体系传导。在影响最大的AGPs淘汰情景下，以2021-2023年不变价格计算，2025-2040年间全球畜牧业累计产量损失约为530亿美元，年度偏离值在2020年代中期达到峰值，随后随产出沿情景设定的恢复路径收敛而下降。相比之下，影响最大的AMR情景因设定机制产生持续且叠加的减产效应，至2040年累计产量损失约达3180亿美元，而该高影响情景下的累计经济福利损失约为1.25万亿美元，主要集中于中高收入国家。研究结果本质上具有情景依赖性，仅代表指示性量级而非预测值。基准情景隐含地反映了历史生产趋势中固有的AGPs与AMR水平。本研究为量化抗生素使用（AMU）的生产效应及其经济溢出提供了分析框架，揭示了在既定情景结构下，采取行动与不采取行动所产生经济成本在时间维度上的非对称性。

title: The elusive quest for disarmed peace: contest games and international relations
title_zh: 寻求解除武装和平的艰难探索：竞争博弈与国际关系
title_primary: 寻求解除武装和平的艰难探索：竞争博弈与国际关系
title_secondary: The elusive quest for disarmed peace: contest games and international relations
authors: Johann Caro-Burnett, Sebastian Galiani, Gustavo Torrens
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic game-theoretic framework to analyze security competition between two states that can invest in a technology to eliminate their rival. Extending the canonical one-shot game, our model incorporates a negotiation (settlement) stage and assumes effective diplomacy, which rules out payoff-dominated equilibria. We fully characterize equilibrium behavior across all discount factors and compare outcomes under high and low elimination costs. The dynamic structure reveals why, even with optimal coordination, long-lasting disarmed peace is rare. By combining the dynamics of military escalation with the constraints of effective diplomacy, the model rationalizes historical cycles of peace, arms races, and conflict. Our approach identifies strategic mechanisms that restrict the sustainability of disarmament and clarifies the conditions under which arms races or conflict become inevitable, offering a deeper understanding of the recurrent nature of international conflict under repeated interaction.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个动态博弈理论框架，用于分析两个国家在投资消除对手技术时的安全竞争。在经典单次博弈的基础上，我们的模型引入了谈判（和解）阶段，并假设有效外交排除了收益占优均衡。我们全面刻画了所有折现因子下的均衡行为，并比较了高消除成本与低消除成本下的结果。动态结构揭示了为何即使在最优协调下，持久的非武装和平也极为罕见。通过将军事升级的动态过程与有效外交的约束相结合，该模型合理化了和平、军备竞赛与冲突的历史循环。我们的方法识别出限制裁军可持续性的战略机制，并阐明了军备竞赛或冲突不可避免的条件，从而在重复互动背景下为理解国际冲突的反复性提供了更深刻的洞见。

title: A tale of two families: marital formation, parental human capital investment and college attainment
title_zh: 两个家庭的故事：婚姻形成、父母人力资本投资与大学教育获得
title_primary: 两个家庭的故事：婚姻形成、父母人力资本投资与大学教育获得
title_secondary: A tale of two families: marital formation, parental human capital investment and college attainment
authors: Chao Wei
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper constructs an overlapping generation model that integrates endogenous marital formation and parental human capital investment decisions to characterize the joint determination of the distributions of family structure and college attainment. We use the model to examine the effects of public policies that reallocate college enrollment opportunities based on students’ social and economic status. We find that such policies may equalize college enrollment rates but lower college completion rates, marriage rates, and overall welfare. These outcomes arise from distorted parental investment incentives and a shift in family composition toward single and non-college-educated households, which invest less in children’s human capital relative to households with college-educated parents. These findings highlight disparities in the family structures in which children grow up as a fundamental source of inequality in college education.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个融合内生婚姻形成与父母人力资本投资决策的世代交叠模型，用以刻画家庭结构与大学教育成就分布的联合决定机制。我们利用该模型考察了基于学生社会经济地位重新分配大学入学机会的公共政策效应。研究发现，此类政策虽可能使大学入学率趋于均等，但会降低大学毕业率、结婚率及整体福利水平。这些结果源于父母投资激励的扭曲，以及家庭构成向单亲及非大学教育背景家庭转变，这类家庭相对于拥有大学教育背景父母的家庭，对子女人力资本的投资较少。这些发现凸显了儿童成长所面临的家庭结构差异，是大学教育不平等的一个根本性来源。

title: Who benefits from a maternity leave extension? Evidence from Chile
title_zh: 产假延长谁受益？来自智利的证据
title_primary: 产假延长谁受益？来自智利的证据
title_secondary: Who benefits from a maternity leave extension? Evidence from Chile
authors: Fernanda Rojas-Ampuero
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the short- and medium-term effects of extending maternity leave on women’s labor market outcomes, exploiting a reform implemented in Chile in 2011 that increased maternity leave from 84 to 168 days. I combine administrative data on leave claims with employer–employee data to estimate the effect of longer leave on women’s employment and wages seven years after childbirth. The results show that, compared to ineligible workers, eligible women extend their maternity leave by 79 days and reduce their use of other sick leave claims. They are more likely to be formally employed for up to three years after giving birth, with no negative effects on earnings. The positive employment effects are driven by women with low labor market attachment prior to giving birth, who experience a reduction in separation rates and an increased likelihood of working under a permanent contract in the medium term. These results suggest that a longer leave incentivizes employment by helping mothers remain in the formal labor market.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了延长产假对女性劳动力市场结果的短期与中期影响，利用智利2011年实施的一项改革，该改革将产假从84天延长至168天。我将行政数据中的产假申请记录与雇主-雇员数据相结合，以估计延长产假对女性分娩后七年内就业和工资的影响。结果显示，与不符合条件的劳动者相比，符合条件的女性产假延长了79天，并减少了其他病假申请的使用。她们在分娩后最多三年内更可能保持正式就业，且对收入无负面影响。积极的就业效应主要由分娩前劳动力市场依附度较低的女性驱动，这些女性的离职率降低，并在中期更可能签订永久合同。这些结果表明，延长产假通过帮助母亲留在正规劳动力市场，激励了就业。

title: The impact of low-carbon pilots policy on health
title_zh: 低碳试点政策对健康的影响
title_primary: 低碳试点政策对健康的影响
title_secondary: The impact of low-carbon pilots policy on health
authors: Hong Cao, Liyan Han, Lei Li, Libo Yin, Peng Yin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper quantifies the health benefits of China’s Low-Carbon Pilot (LCP) policy using individual-level mortality records. Exploiting staggered policy adoption and estimating dynamic treatment effects with the Sun and Abraham (2021) approach, we find that LCP implementation reduces pollution-related mortality among older adults by 12.6%, with the largest declines in cardiovascular, ischemic heart, and cerebrovascular deaths. The mechanism evidence points to improved air quality—achieved mainly through stronger fiscal support and tighter regulatory enforcement—and the effects are amplified in places led by younger, career-motivated officials, underscoring sizeable health benefits from climate-oriented environmental regulation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用个体层面的死亡记录，量化了中国低碳试点政策的健康效益。通过利用政策分阶段实施的特点，并采用Sun和Abraham（2021）的方法估计动态处理效应，我们发现低碳试点政策的实施使老年人中与污染相关的死亡率降低了12.6%，其中心血管疾病、缺血性心脏病和脑血管疾病的死亡人数降幅最大。机制证据表明，空气质量改善——主要通过加强财政支持和更严格的监管执法实现——是主要驱动因素，且这一效应在由较年轻、有职业晋升动机的官员领导的地区更为显著，凸显了以气候为导向的环境规制带来的可观健康收益。

title: Safe voting: resilience to abstention and sybils
title_zh: 安全投票：对弃权与女巫攻击的鲁棒性
title_primary: 安全投票：对弃权与女巫攻击的鲁棒性
title_secondary: Safe voting: resilience to abstention and sybils
authors: Reshef Meir, Gal Shahaf, Ehud Shapiro, Nimrod Talmon
official: 官方在线 2025-12-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Voting rules may implement the will of society when all eligible voters vote, and only them. However, they may fail to do so when sybil (fake or duplicate) votes are present and when only some honest (non-sybil) voters actively participate. As this is often the case, our aim here is to address social choice in the presence of sybils and voter abstention. To do so, we build upon the framework of Reality-aware Social Choice: we assume the status quo as an ever-present distinguished alternative, and study status quo Enforcing (SQE) voting rules , which add virtual votes in support of the status quo. We characterize the tradeoff between safety and liveness (the ability of active honest voters to maintain/change the status quo, respectively) in several domains, and show that the voting rules are often optimal. Our characterization identifies the exact conditions under which mechanisms remain both resilient to sybils and responsive to verified participation, offering a quantitative tool for designers to measure the benefit of increased participation and verified identities. We comment on the applicability of our methods and analyses to the governance of digital communities.
abstract_zh: 投票规则在全体合格选民参与投票时，能够实现社会意愿，且仅在此情况下成立。然而，当存在虚假（伪造或重复）投票，且仅有部分诚实（非虚假）选民积极参与时，这些规则可能失效。鉴于这种情况普遍存在，本文旨在解决存在虚假投票和选民弃权时的社会选择问题。为此，我们基于"现实感知社会选择"框架展开研究：将现状视为始终存在的特殊备选项，并研究"现状强制执行"投票规则——该规则通过增加支持现状的虚拟投票来实现。我们在多个领域刻画了安全性与活跃性（分别指活跃诚实选民维持/改变现状的能力）之间的权衡关系，并证明这些投票规则通常具有最优性。我们的刻画揭示了机制在保持对虚假投票的韧性同时，又能对已验证参与做出响应的确切条件，为设计者提供了衡量参与度提升与身份验证效益的量化工具。最后，我们讨论了研究方法与分析结果在数字社区治理中的适用性。本文为订阅内容预览，需通过机构登录以获取访问权限。

title: Nonresponse Bias in Household Inflation Expectations Surveys
title_zh: 家庭通胀预期调查中的无应答偏差
title_primary: 家庭通胀预期调查中的无应答偏差
title_secondary: Nonresponse Bias in Household Inflation Expectations Surveys
authors: MELTEM CHADWICK, RENNAE CHERRY, JAQUESON K. GALIMBERTI
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-10-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses microdata from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's Household Inflation Expectations survey to evaluate the effects of nonresponses to the inflation expectations question in the survey. We find nonresponses lead to substantial underrepresentation of some demographic groups in the survey: young, female, low‐income, and minority ethnic groups have lower response rates. How the survey is conducted also affects item response rates. The survey response rates increase when the survey is conducted online and when inflation rates deviate from the central bank's target range. Using a sample selection model, we assess whether the survey has item nonresponse bias by comparing the demographic characteristics of responders and nonresponders. After accounting for selection, we find that observed differences in inflation expectations by gender, ethnicity, and income decrease substantially, while differences by age increase. We quantify and demonstrate how to adjust average aggregate and subgroup inflation expectations for bias caused by item nonresponse. We show that there is a positive bias, and the aggregate and subgroup inflation expectation series shift down after the adjustment. We also show that inflation expectations disagreement, both across and within subgroups, tends to decrease with the correction for nonresponse bias. These findings have important implications for survey design and monetary policy communication.
abstract_zh: 本文利用新西兰储备银行家庭通胀预期调查的微观数据，评估调查中通胀预期问题未答复的影响。我们发现，未答复导致调查中某些人口群体代表性严重不足：年轻、女性、低收入及少数族裔群体的答复率较低。调查实施方式也影响项目答复率。当调查在线进行且通胀率偏离中央银行目标区间时，调查答复率上升。利用样本选择模型，我们通过比较答复者与未答复者的人口特征，评估调查是否存在项目未答复偏差。在考虑选择效应后，我们发现按性别、族裔和收入划分的通胀预期观测差异显著缩小，而按年龄划分的差异则增大。我们量化并展示了如何调整平均总体及子群体通胀预期以纠正项目未答复造成的偏差。结果表明存在正向偏差，调整后总体及子群体通胀预期序列下移。我们还发现，通胀预期分歧，无论是子群体内部还是子群体之间，在纠正未答复偏差后趋于减小。这些发现对调查设计和货币政策沟通具有重要意义。

abstract: This paper combines bioeconomic theory and econometrics to develop a coupled model of fishing effort and stock dynamics. We apply the model to the lake whitefish fishery in the Great Lakes. The results provide support for the standard bioeconomic model of renewable resource exploitation in which fishing effort adjusts symmetrically with respect to profit and loss, but also that effort is affected by seasonal factors and drift. When we simulate the system for lake whitefish, we find that over the long run effort adjusts slowly toward zero or a small recurring level. JEL C22D22Q22
abstract_zh: 本文融合生物经济理论与计量经济学方法，构建了捕捞努力量与资源存量动态耦合模型，并将其应用于五大湖白鲑渔业。研究结果支持可再生资源开发的标准生物经济模型，即捕捞努力量对利润与亏损呈对称调整，同时努力量还受季节性因素及漂移影响。对白鲑系统的模拟显示，长期内努力量缓慢趋向于零或小幅周期性水平。JEL分类号：C22，D22，Q22
